# Miscellania and Etceteria

The two islands of areas/area_miscellania. Reached by the longship from Rellekka, which gates.ts lists out of scope (TRANSPORTS_OUT_OF_SCOPE: its own sail proc, areas/area_miscellania/scripts/misc_sailor.rs2:13), so the world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn does not reach the islands, their bank or their shops (build.ts unreached report).
